messages:
releasebot: tag `v2.14.0-rc2` created from commit `3a7f9e4` and pushed to `origin`. changelog digest: minor perf improvements for batching, fix kv-cache edge case (customer A), docstring cleanup. breaking: none. envs: canary -> staging -> prod. cc @sre_jess for canary window :rocket:

deploybot: starting canary rollout to `canary` at 1749894330. target hosts: gpu-pool-canary-1..3. expected ~30m. image: `redwood/runtime:2.14.0-rc2`

eng_ryan: thanks. quick ask — can we pin `staging` to `v2.13.9` until we confirm evals?

pm_omar: +1 on pin staging, want to run the smoke prompt-set and the cost regression checks first.

sre_jess: noted. will monitor latency and error rates. starting synthetic traffic in 5m. if 95p latency > 200ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% -> abort and rollback plan.

devex_anna: FYI the docs site will need the small changelog blurb. uploading shortnotes now: https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/v2.14.0-rc2

releasebot: canary finished partial rollout at 1749894490; 2/3 hosts healthy, latency stable, no increase in 5xx. marking canary:pass.

deploybot: promoting to `staging` (pin requested) at 1749894520. Note: config flag `kv_cache_strict` enabled in this tag (opt-in).

eng_ryan: staging pinned to `v2.13.9` for now — please do not promote to prod until QA sign-off.

pm_omar: running evals now, will post results within 30m. if regressions < 1% for quality metrics we greenlight.

sre_jess: observed an intermittent mem spike on canary host #2 during longer sequences (~3k tokens) — keeping watch. not critical but logging.

releasebot: note in changelog: "KV cache strictness fix may increase memory transiently for long contexts; see mitigation steps." Added link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-long-contexts

deploybot: if QA fails or mem spike crosses threshold, rollback target will be `v2.13.9` via `git tag` revert + image redeploy. rollback windows: immediate for canary/staging, for prod coordinate with SRE on change window.

pm_omar: evals done — quality diffs: -0.3% embedding accuracy, +0.1% generation fluency. looks good. ops, any objections to prod rollout after 1h of staging soak?

sre_jess: prefer to wait 1h and confirm mem spike not reproducible. after that we can schedule prod push in next change window (20:00 UTC).

eng_ryan: logged a follow-up ticket to add a guarded mem cap to runtime to avoid surprises in prod.

releasebot: release notes finalized and pinned to docs at 1749894900. changelog full: https://internal.redwood/releases/2.14.0-rc2/changelog.md

deploybot: done with staging rollout at 1749894950. awaiting QA sign-off for prod. when ready, run `/deploy promote v2.14.0-rc2 --env prod --window 20:00-21:00UTC`. :thumbsup:
